Name: PlacementPlus
Author: 2Retr0
Description:
[size=5][b][size=6]PlacementPlus[/size][/b]
Description
[/size]Annoyed by how restricted placing objects can be sometimes in Stardew Valley? This mod introduces some very convenient quality-of-life
placement mechanics—specifically...

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OrsIN50.gif[/img]﻿[b]Being able to swap flooring without needing to break them![/b] [i](Inspired by the very useful block swap feature from Terraria).[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lflChfB.gif[/img][b]Flooring can now also be placed under any object![/b] [i](This includes under buildings, shipping bins, and those pesky mailboxes!)[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/HFrqlGu.gif[/img][b]Additionally, being able to swap chests![/b] [i](Works between stone and wooden chests!)[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/O1BUDs6.gif[/img][b]Swapping fences works too![/b] [i](Gates, iron, hardwood—you name it!)[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JULHymr.gif[/img]﻿[b]Unrestricted building on any walkable tile![/b] [i](Yes, you can trap yourself if you tried.)[/i]


[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5 on Windows. (Untested on Linux/Mac but should work fine!)
[/list][list]
[*]Works in single player and multiplayer.
[/list]
